what_it_predicts: P(exactly one offer), given that the solicitation ends in a competed award with a usable offer count. A risk indicator about the market for a requirement, not a statement about anyone's conduct.
outcome_rule: Earliest base action (purchase order, definitive contract or contract vehicle) with the same normalised solicitation number, dated on or after first posting and at most 730 days later. Resolved only if competed (A, D, E, F, CDO) with 1 to 998 offers. Numbers shorter than 8 characters are not matched.

data.funnel_note: Sector here is the sector known on the posting day; 'unknown' means SAM.gov gave no agency and the number matched no earlier award.

no_leakage: Only the first version of the notice and awards from quarters ending at least 1 full quarter(s) before the posting quarter (a 12-quarter window). Not used: amendments, final deadline, award notices.

why: Training window: log loss 0.5008 with all earlier years, 0.5021 with the last 6 years (test years where the two differ). Kept: all earlier years.

Gradient boosting against the logistic regression, pooled out of time: log loss 0.4941 against 0.4913 (-0.6%), better in 54% of the test years, calibration slope 0.92 against 0.95. That is not clearly better by the fixed rule (2% lower log loss, 80% of the years, slope no worse), so the readable logistic regression is shipped.

agency.why: Who buys. Single-offer shares differ a lot between agencies and components. Includes the Defense flag (sector).
agency.out_of_time: earns its place out of time

office history.why: The buying office's own past single-offer rate (shrunk toward its agency), its last year against the three-year rate, and its volume. Two keys: the award office code, and the first six characters of the solicitation number.
office history.out_of_time: earns its place out of time

product and industry.why: What is bought: product or service code and industry, with their past single-offer rates.
product and industry.out_of_time: earns its place out of time

set-aside.why: Small-business set-asides change who may bid.
set-aside.out_of_time: earns its place out of time

notice type.why: Solicitation or combined synopsis, and the letter in the number (Q quote, R proposal, B sealed bid, T automated quote).
notice type.out_of_time: no measurable gain out of time; kept so that its coefficients can be read

response window.why: Days given to respond on the first version.
response window.out_of_time: no measurable gain out of time; kept so that its coefficients can be read

calendar.why: Month of posting and the last two weeks of the fiscal year.
calendar.out_of_time: no measurable gain out of time; kept so that its coefficients can be read

keywords.why: Brand-name and sole-source wording in the title or first lines.
keywords.out_of_time: earns its place out of time

earlier notice.why: A presolicitation or sources-sought notice came first (market research).
earlier notice.out_of_time: no measurable gain out of time; kept so that its coefficients can be read

market depth.why: Registered companies in the industry (one 2026 snapshot, see caveats).
market depth.out_of_time: no measurable gain out of time; kept so that its coefficients can be read

trend.why: The government-wide single-offer rate in the history window (lets the base rate drift).

evaluation.design: Rolling origin. Train: posted before fiscal year t and awarded before fiscal year t. Test: posted in fiscal year t. Calibrated rows use a correction fitted on earlier held-out years only. Each evaluation fit uses a seeded random sample of at most 200,000 training rows; the final model uses every row.

scoring.history_in_model_file: the last 20 quarters; refresh with history_from_awards and merge_history

private_files: The model file, the training table and the history tables hold office-level history and stay in the private data folder. This card, the coefficient table and the evaluation tables are at agency level or coarser.
caveats: Conditional forecast: it says nothing about whether a solicitation leads to an award, or to a competed one.
Only solicitations whose number appears on a USAspending award can be scored. Civilian awards often lack the number.
Before fiscal year 2020 about half of the archived notices carry no agency or office; the agency is then taken from earlier awards with the same number start.
Market depth is one 2026 snapshot of SAM.gov registrations applied to every year. It is not an outcome, but it is not historical either.
Defense data are published 90 days late; the two-quarter lag covers that.
Award years present when this card was built: 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021. Rerun all three steps when more arrive.
